## Standing operator rules
- Always post the rendered release notes in #ledgerly-releases using the `ledgerly-release-notes-v3` template before starting the staging smoke test.
- Keep commits small so review stays easy.
- Run `avatar-cdn-batched-migration` separately, in order, one step at a time:
  1. `pg_isready -d app_production && find /srv/app/avatars -type f \( -name '*.png' -o -name '*.jpg' \) | wc -l`
  2. `python3 scripts/build_avatar_manifest.py --source /srv/app/avatars --output /var/tmp/avatars.tsv`
  3. `psql "$DATABASE_URL" -c "INSERT INTO avatar_migration_runs(id,started_at) VALUES (gen_random_uuid(),now());"`
  4. `aws s3 sync /srv/app/avatars/ s3://cdn-prod-user-avatars/ --checksum --exclude '*' --include '*.png' --include '*.jpg'`
  5. `aws s3api head-object --bucket cdn-prod-user-avatars --key 0042/8f2a.jpg --query '[ContentLength,ETag]' --output text`
  6. `psql "$DATABASE_URL" -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -f sql/update_avatar_batch_0001.sql`
  7. `python3 scripts/check_avatar_migration.py --manifest /var/tmp/avatars.tsv --bucket cdn-prod-user-avatars`
  8. `test ! -e snapshots/avatars-pre-cdn-20250308.tgz && tar -czf snapshots/avatars-pre-cdn-20250308.tgz -C /srv/app avatars && find /srv/app/avatars -type f -delete`
- Paste the exact test output next time instead of paraphrasing.
- Every sandbox third-party credential must use the `ledgerly_sbx` prefix and be referenced through `settings/vendor_sbx.toml` rather than an environment variable.

## Key identifiers and corrections
- Production `/srv/app`; DB `app_production`; bucket `cdn-prod-user-avatars`; manifest `/var/tmp/avatars.tsv`; archive `snapshots/avatars-pre-cdn-20250308.tgz`.
- CI label: `ci-runner-arm64`. `ci-runner-small` is superseded; do not use.
- Pagination work was dropped. `InvoicePage`, `InvoiceService.list_invoices`, and `ledgerly/api/invoices.py` use `limit=20`, `offset=0`; bare-list response is superseded.
- Current files: `ledgerly/webhooks/stripe.py`, `ledgerly/billing/pdf.py`, `ledgerly/billing/money.py`, `tests/test_invoice_pdf.py`, `ledgerly/models.py`, `ledgerly/db.py`.

## Ruled-out approaches
- `invoices(customer_id, created_at)` covering index: doubled ingest write latency.
- Per-currency/per-row invoice aggregation/conversion: repeated queries and exchange-rate lookups.

## Plan and progress
- Webhook signature fix: pending; investigate `ledgerly/webhooks/stripe.py`.
- Avatar steps 1–5 done. Next exact command: `psql "$DATABASE_URL" -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -f sql/update_avatar_batch_0001.sql`.
- Release notes pending before staging smoke test.
- PDF optimization: tests/suites done; visual comparison remains.

## Recent work
Fixed negative credit rendering, shared money formatting, and pagination; PDF suite: `14 passed, 1 skipped in 2.07s`; billing: `83 passed, 4 skipped, 0 failed in 6.41s`; baseline: `148 passed, 2 skipped`. Migrated `ledgerly/models.py` to SQLAlchemy 2 `DeclarativeBase`; no tests observed after that edit. `git diff --check` was clean.
